'''Water-wall''' was a recreational activity that could be played on<ref name="GHH" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]] by members of the [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In addition to developing [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]], the Tynnan [[Thief/Legends|thief]] and demolitions expert [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] spent his [[Time/Legends|time]] playing water-wall during the first eighteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of his life.<ref name="GHH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Water-wall was mentioned in "[[The Great Herdship Heist]]", a short story written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and featured in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|the fifteenth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' in [[November]] [[1997]].<ref name="GHH" />
